caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Methods identify P1369 as methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative Staphylococcus, while some DBAASP/dbAMP rows label it Staphylococcus aureus.
APD6 AP04543 aggregates source-supported Kn2-7 rows but its HC50 wording conflicts with the primary Figure 1D/Results HC50 value; not normalized away.
dbAMP rows contain source-supported 2012 MIC subsets plus unsupported/cross-paper target and cell-line values; unsupported tails remain source_conflict.
Figure 1A/C/D and Figures 4-7 were used only for source-supported sequence/screening/hemolysis/mechanism context; exact graph-only bar or curve point values were not invented.
Local supplementary files are HTML/image captures with no parsed spreadsheet or table; they did not change activity/toxicity/mechanism/database conclusions.
